text: New Era Cap is the family-owned company of the Koch family of Buffalo, New York, led by fourth-generation CEO Christopher H. Koch. In August 2022 ACON Investments closed a roughly $700 million continuation round for New Era Cap under which the NFL, NBA and MLB all became minority investors.
short: New Era Cap is the Koch family's family-owned company; the NFL, NBA and MLB took minority stakes in 2022.

source.name: Jackie Robinson Foundation: Christopher Koch, board member
source.quote: Christopher H. Koch is the fourth generation CEO of the family-owned company New Era.

additionalSources.name: Front Office Sports: New Era Cap Adds NFL, NBA, MLB As Investors
additionalSources.quote: The NFL, NBA, and MLB all became minority investors in New Era.
additionalSources.note: The article reports ACON Investments closed a single-asset continuation round of around $700 million for New Era Cap.
